qualityRuleCatalog.threshold: Full-time undergraduate with <12 attempted credits
Status must be in the institution's FT/PT code set
Program must exist and be active for the term
One row per student + term + program
Credits earned cannot exceed attempted credits
Attempted and earned credits must be >= 0
Term GPA must be between 0.0 and 4.0
Age at entry must be between 14 and 100
Every enrolled row must reference a governed term
Race/ethnicity cannot be blank for reporting
Race/ethnicity must map to IPEDS codes 1–9
Sex/gender must map to the governed reporting set
Residency must be in the governed residency set
Flag published demographic cells with n < 10
Completer must have matching enrollment history
CIP must use numeric xx.xxxx format
AWLEVEL must be in the official valid set
Completion date cannot precede entry date
One row per student + program + completion term
Aid recipient must have enrollment in the award term
Aid amount must be nonnegative and below the governed ceiling
Pell eligibility must reconcile to governed aid attributes
Enrolled count cannot exceed section capacity
Zero-enrollment active sections require review
Active section must have assigned faculty
Faculty FTE must remain within the governed range
Faculty meeting times cannot overlap
All declared foreign-key paths must resolve
Coded columns cannot introduce unrecognized values
Table row count cannot move >40% without explanation
Enrollment headcount variance outside ±2.5% requires explanation
Completion count variance outside ±10% requires explanation
Aid total variance outside ±10% requires explanation
CIP changes require an effective-dated bridge
Potential duplicate identities require adjudication
